capabilities: Generate a task timetable from Markdown task lists
Parse estimated times and optional start times in task descriptions
Complete or interrupt the topmost task and record actual times
Recreate interrupted tasks with their remaining estimated time
Color-code tasks by whether their scheduled start time is feasible
extras: Beta versions can be installed via BRAT.
intentEvidence: This plugin was inspired by タスクシュート(TaskChute).
problem: Obsidian has no built-in way to turn tasks with estimated durations into an automatically scheduled timetable.

relations.evidence: This plugin was inspired by タスクシュート(TaskChute).

summary: Task scheduling plugin that generates a dynamic timetable from estimated task times written in Markdown files.
